subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Acute lymphoblastic leukaemia: lineage classification, Philadelphia chromosome management, MRD monitoring and targeted immunotherapies

steps.tx: Acute lymphoblastic leukaemia is immunophenotypically classified into B-cell lineage **B-ALL** and T-cell lineage **T-ALL**. B-ALL blasts express surface antigens **CD19**, **CD22**, CD79a, and nuclear terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase **TdT**. In contrast, T-ALL blasts express cytoplasmic **CD3** and **CD7**, frequently presenting in young males with high circulating leukocyte counts and bulky anterior mediastinal masses.
steps.say: Acute lymphoblastic leukaemia is immunophenotypically classified into B-cell lineage B-ALL and T-cell lineage T-ALL. B-ALL blasts express surface antigens CD19, CD22, CD79a, and nuclear terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase TdT. In contrast, T-ALL blasts express cytoplasmic CD3 and CD7, frequently presenting in young males with high circulating leukocyte counts and bulky anterior mediastinal masses.

left.title: B-Lineage ALL (B-ALL)
points: Accounts for 75% to 80% of adult ALL
Expresses CD19, CD22, CD79a, and TdT
Common cytogenetics: t(9;22), t(v;11q23), hypodiploidy
Targetable with blinatumomab, inotuzumab, CAR-T

right.title: T-Lineage ALL (T-ALL)
points: Accounts for 20% to 25% of adult ALL
Expresses cytoplasmic CD3, CD7, and CD5
Bulky anterior mediastinal masses, pleural effusions
Early T-precursor (ETP) subtype has poor prognosis

steps.tx: Philadelphia chromosome-positive **Ph+ ALL** harbouring the reciprocal translocation **t(9;22)** BCR-ABL1 historically carried an extremely poor prognosis. Incorporating potent BCR-ABL **tyrosine kinase inhibitors** such as **dasatinib** or **ponatinib** into front-line chemotherapy produces complete haematological remission in over 95% of patients, transforming long-term survival and allowing chemotherapy de-intensification.
steps.say: Philadelphia chromosome-positive Ph+ ALL harbouring the reciprocal translocation t(9;22) BCR-ABL1 historically carried an extremely poor prognosis. steps.tx: Bispecific CD19/CD3 T-cell engager **Blinatumomab** redirects host CD3-positive cytotoxic T lymphocytes against CD19-positive lymphoblasts. In the landmark phase III **TOWER trial**, blinatumomab achieved significantly higher complete remission rates, deeper **minimal residual disease** MRD clearance, and prolonged overall survival compared to standard intensive salvage chemotherapy in relapsed or refractory B-ALL.
steps.say: Bispecific CD19/CD3 T-cell engager Blinatumomab provides targeted redirection of host CD3-positive cytotoxic T lymphocytes against CD19-positive lymphoblasts. In the landmark phase III TOWER trial, blinatumomab achieved significantly higher complete remission rates, deeper minimal residual disease MRD clearance, and prolonged overall survival compared to standard intensive salvage chemotherapy in relapsed or refractory B-ALL.

left.title: Blinatumomab Arm (TOWER)
points: Complete remission rate: 44% vs 25%
Median overall survival: 7.7 vs 4.0 months (HR 0.71)
High rate of molecular MRD clearance
Administered as 28-day continuous IV infusion

right.title: Standard Salvage Chemotherapy
points: High-dose multi-agent cytotoxic regimens
Severe myelosuppression and febrile neutropenia
High treatment-related early mortality
Lower rates of bridge to curative allogeneic transplant

steps.tx: **Minimal residual disease** (MRD) is the strongest prognostic factor. A molecular complete remission after induction predicts disease-free survival near 70 percent, versus under 40 percent if MRD is positive. Blinatumomab, a bispecific T-cell engager given as a continuous infusion over 28 days, improves survival when added to consolidation in MRD-negative patients and converts MRD-positive patients. Monitor for cytokine release syndrome and neurotoxicity.

steps.tx: CD22-directed antibody-drug conjugate **Inotuzumab ozogamicin** delivers a potent cytotoxic calicheamicin payload directly into malignant B-lymphoblasts. In the pivotal randomized phase III **INO-VATE trial**, inotuzumab ozogamicin produced significantly higher complete remission rates and MRD negativity compared to standard salvage chemotherapy, enabling more patients to undergo curative allogeneic stem cell transplantation.

steps.tx: Autologous anti-CD19 chimeric antigen receptor CAR-T cell therapy **Tisagenlecleucel** delivers durable remissions in relapsed or refractory pediatric and young adult B-ALL. In the pivotal **ELIANA trial**, a single infusion produced an 81% overall remission rate, with 100% of responding patients achieving deep flow-cytometric MRD negativity and durable multi-year event-free survival.

steps.tx: Serial quantitative **Minimal residual disease** MRD evaluation represents the most powerful independent prognostic predictor in ALL. Assessed by high-sensitivity multiparameter flow cytometry or NGS-based immunoglobulin heavy chain rearrangement assays with sensitivity reaching 1 in 1,000,000 cells, persistent post-induction MRD positivity dictates immediate treatment intensification or consolidative allogeneic stem cell transplantation.

left.title: MRD Negative (< 0.01% / 10^-4)
points: Deep morphological and immunophenotypic clearance
5-year relapse-free survival exceeding 75%
Standard consolidation without upfront transplant in good-risk
Monitored longitudinally every 3 months

right.title: MRD Positive (>= 0.01%)
points: Presence of persistent submicroscopic leukemia clones
High relapse risk exceeding 70% within 2 years
Mandates blinatumomab immunotherapy to convert to negative
Definitive indication for allogeneic stem cell transplantation

steps.tx: Routine **CNS prophylaxis** is mandatory for all ALL patients to prevent leptomeningeal relapse. Standard regimens deliver **intrathecal methotrexate**, cytarabine, and hydrocortisone triple intrathecal therapy through serial lumbar punctures during induction and consolidation, reducing central nervous system recurrence from over 30% down to under 5%.

steps.tx: Therapeutic **L-asparaginase** depletes extracellular asparagine, starving leukemic blasts unable to synthesize this amino acid. Clinical monitoring mandates active surveillance for acute chemical **pancreatitis**, severe **hyperammonemia**, hepatic transaminitis with coagulopathy, and life-threatening thrombosis secondary to acute **antithrombin III depletion**, requiring antithrombin repletion and therapeutic anticoagulation.

rows: Thrombosis risk; monitor levels; replete antithrombin
Hydration; lactulose; hold therapy if symptomatic
Switch from E. coli to Erwinia chrysanthemi preparation
